findings.title: Layers, thickness and copper weight
findings.message: The board has 4 copper layers. PCBWay's standard price is for 2 layers; 4 layers cost extra and may not be covered by the sponsored round.
findings.fix: Ask the course staff before ordering more than 2 layers, or move the design to 2 layers.

checks.title: Power track width for the rated current
Vias where the power path changes layer
Hot loop: input capacitor at the switches

findings.title: Hot loop: input capacitor at the switches
findings.message: No ceramic capacitor found between the input and ground. Electrolytic caps alone cannot supply the fast switching current; the switch node will ring.
findings.fix: Put 1-3 ceramic capacitors (e.g. 2.2-10 µF 100 V X7R) right at the switches, across input and ground.

checks.title: Gate driver close to the MOSFETs

findings.title: Gate driver close to the MOSFETs
findings.message: U3 pin 3 is 16 mm from the gate of Q2. A long gate loop slows switching and picks up noise.
findings.fix: Move the driver within about 15 mm of the MOSFET, and run the gate and its return (source) side by side.

findings.message: Q1 is a through-hole power package. Check its losses: at 60 W it may need a heatsink (with insulation if the tab is not grounded).

findings.title: Decoupling capacitors at IC supply pins
findings.message: U2 pin 1 (VI_1) has no small (<= 1 µF) capacitor to ground on +12V.
findings.fix: Add a 100 nF ceramic capacitor right at the pin, with its ground pad going straight to ground.

findings.title: Decoupling capacitors at IC supply pins
findings.message: U3 pin 1 (VDD_1) has no small (<= 1 µF) capacitor to ground on +12V.
findings.fix: Add a 100 nF ceramic capacitor right at the pin, with its ground pad going straight to ground.
